description: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight clients, a fork of Apollo/Sunshine. Installs system-wide via its bundled MSI.
notes: Vibepollo is a system-wide install (default: '%ProgramFiles%\Apollo'), not a portable app.
install, update and uninstall all require an elevated shell.
'scoop update vibepollo' runs an in-place MSI major upgrade: config, apps, and paired clients are preserved.

script: if (!(is_admin)) { error "'$app' requires admin rights to $cmd. Re-run scoop from an elevated shell."; break }
# The setup .exe is a bootstrapper around a WiX MSI with a stable UpgradeCode, and the
# prerelease suffix is encoded into the ProductVersion, so every release is a real major
# upgrade. Running it over an existing install upgrades in place inside one transaction.

$succ = Invoke-ExternalCommand "$dir\VibepolloSetup.exe" -ArgumentList @('/qn', '/norestart') -Activity 'Running Vibepollo installer ...' -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'A restart is required to finish the Vibepollo upgrade.' }
if (!$succ) { error 'Vibepollo installer failed.'; break }
if ($cmd -eq 'update') {
# 'scoop update' runs the outgoing manifest's uninstaller before installing the new
# version. Skip it: the MSI upgrades in place, whereas a real uninstall would tear down
# the service, virtual display driver and firewall rules just to put them back.
Write-Host 'Skipping uninstall: Vibepollo upgrades in place.' -ForegroundColor Yellow
} else {
if (!(is_admin)) { error "'$app' requires admin rights to $cmd. Re-run scoop from an elevated shell."; break }
$entry = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*', 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq 'Vibepollo' -and $_.UninstallString -like '*uninstall.exe*' } | Select-Object -First 1
$uninst = if ($entry) { ($entry.UninstallString -replace '"', '').Trim() } else { "$env:ProgramFiles\Apollo\uninstall.exe" }
if (Test-Path $uninst) {
$succ = Invoke-ExternalCommand $uninst -ArgumentList @('/quiet') -Activity 'Running Vibepollo uninstaller ...' -ContinueExitCodes @{ 3010 = 'A restart is required to finish removing Vibepollo.' }
if (!$succ) { error 'Vibepollo uninstaller failed.'; break }
} else {
warn 'Vibepollo uninstaller not found; nothing to remove.'
